action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider also pruning out-of-list routes/stops on Reset for defense in depth (current implementation re-sets whole FeatureCollection so this is fine).
critical_code_review_comments: maplibreAdapter.setTrucks previously only added markers and never removed trucks that had been dropped from state (e.g. after Reset demo removing T-105). Fixed in-place by diffing the incoming list against the internal `trucks` Map. Recommend a small unit test or at least a comment to keep this invariant going forward.

RecordDrawer save() does not auto-close the drawer or clear the local `form` state after Save; this is intentional for stacked edits but creates a tiny UX quirk — the modal overlay blocks fleet-back-to-dashboard until the user hits Close/Escape. Consider auto-closing on first clean Save (or at least focusing the Close button).

FleetPage.tables() computes the carrier rows as `[data.carrier, ...Object.values(data.carriers)]`. If an intake-created carrier happens to have the same id or name as the seeded one it will double-count. Low risk (ids are CAR-* vs CAR-1 seed) but worth a dedupe pass.

intakeParser.PARSERS.truck defaults equipment to EQUIPMENT[0] when no match — a user describing a reefer with the wrong keyword could silently save a dry van. Fine for a demo; worth flagging on the confirmation card if confidence is low.
